title: Parents Night Out
seo_title: Parents Night Out in Joplin, MO – Dec 11, 2026
description: Parents Night Out is a drop-off event where children ages 3-12 enjoy food, games, Christmas crafts, and a movie while parents get a few hours to shop, wrap presents, have a date night, or relax. It is free for children ages 3-12, and advance sign-up through the Facebook event or registration form is requested so the church can prepare; no church membership is needed. It takes place December 11, 2026 (Time TBD) at Joplin First Church of the Nazarene, 2124 Utica St, Joplin, MO.
